column4: 8 deaths - Over 1,200 homes were severely damaged, 301 of which were destroyed. Many mobile homes were flattened and major tree damage occurred. 25 additional people were injured.
column5: 13 deaths - 86 homes were destroyed and an additional 144 were damaged. Many mobile homes were destroyed as well in Lake County. In Volusia County, 106 homes were destroyed and 277 others were damaged. 51 additional people were injured.
column6: Structural damage to many homes, mainly roof and chimney damage. Carports, garage doors, and pool screens were damaged as well.
column7: A house suffered roof damage, two sheds were blown over, and several citrus trees were downed.
